source: a replay re-runs its replay block's whole batch from the block's edge state in the served batch layout, at 0.97-1.02x serving's busy GPU-seconds (measured on Moonlight at 1x H200 and on GLM-5.3 at TP8, mid-traffic, GLM-5.3 served at a 40,960-token context limit); unmeasured at a 131,072-token context, where the factor is still read at 1.0: the one replay at that context ran saturated with captures on and was timed by wall clock, which doesn't compare with busy GPU-seconds; GLM-5.3 replays bit-exact at TP8 with the deterministic DSA top-k, so a sampled request costs its replay block's whole batch unless kernels are batch-invariant
